# 🛡️ Threat Assessment Template

## Scope and assets
List PBIX, workbook, screenshots, GitHub repository, workflows, credentials, and optional Service workspace.

## Threat scenarios
| Asset | Threat actor | Entry point | Attack path | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Existing controls
Describe actual permissions, data minimization, secret handling, workflow permissions, and sharing restrictions.

## Risk rating
| Threat | Likelihood | Impact | Residual risk | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Mitigations and verification
For each mitigation define the change, test, evidence, owner, and completion date.

## Review
Record reviewer, assumptions, accepted risks, and next review trigger.
